facts.text: John expressed that the photo reminded him of a childhood experience with a doll that made him feel better.

evidence.quote: It reminds me of something from my childhood. I had a little doll like this and it always made me feel better.

facts.text: Maria mentioned that she noticed a little girl around 8 years old sitting alone and seemed sad.

evidence.quote: I noticed a little girl around 8 sitting all alone. She seemed so sad.

facts.text: Maria shared that she sat with the little girl and talked to her, eventually leading to laughter and a good time.

evidence.quote: I was able to give her some comfort and a listening ear. We ended up laughing and having a good time.

facts.text: John acknowledged the importance of supporting each other when feeling down and noted the impact of kind gestures.

evidence.quote: It's important to support each other when we're feeling down. You never know the difference a kind gesture can make.
